entries.source:
#{italic}#From the notes of Darwood Oakton, explorer:
#{bold}#CHAPTER ONE: THE SHER'TUL

#{normal}#The Sher'Tul. Who were they? Where did they come from? Where did they go? The mysteries surrounding this ancient race are almost infinite. What little scraps of information we have regarding them allude to a mighty and world-spanning civilisation, wielding power and magic unthinkable. Now, however, all that remains of them are forgotten, wind-swept ruins, the tiniest minutiae of their technology sealed away in the studies of reclusive sages. Does their mystery not call to your curious nature as it does mine, gentle reader?

My quest has drawn me into the Old Forest. What is there to be said about a place like "the old forest"? It is a forest, and it is old. By its unimaginative moniker you can guess how important this place is to the people of Derth; the only locals who commonly venture under its boughs are novice alchemists in search of ingredients, plus the odd hunter with his sights set low. However, the story of this old forest now takes a more interesting twist...

Rumours are growing of trees roaming in its depths, moving as you or I would. Some even claim that they now possess the spark of sentience. The Sher'Tul were rumoured to hold the power of animism... is this mere coincidence?
entries.target:
#{italic}#摘自探险家达沃德·欧卡顿的笔记：
#{bold}#第一章：夏·图尔

#{normal}#夏·图尔。他们是谁？从何而来？又去了哪里？围绕这个古老种族的谜团几乎无穷无尽。我们掌握的寥寥资料，只隐约指向一个强盛而遍及世界的文明，他们驾驭着难以想象的力量与魔法。

然而如今，他们只剩下遭人遗忘、饱受风蚀的废墟；其技术最细微的片段，也被封存在离群索居的贤者书斋中。亲爱的读者，他们的谜团是否也像呼唤我一样，唤起了你的好奇心？

我的探寻将我带进了古老森林。对于一个叫作“古老森林”的地方，还能说些什么？它是一片森林，而且很古老。只看这毫无新意的名字，你就能猜到德斯人有多么重视这里：当地经常走入林荫之下的，只有寻找材料的新手炼金术师，外加偶尔几个志向不高的猎人。不过，这片古老森林的故事如今有了更有趣的转折……

越来越多的传言声称，森林深处的树会像你我一样四处行走。甚至有人说，它们如今已经萌生了心智。传说夏·图尔拥有赋予万物灵性的力量……这难道只是巧合？

entries.source:
Allows a chronomancer to timeport to Point Zero.
	You have studied the chronomancy there and have been granted a special portal spell to teleport back.
	This spell must be kept secret; it should never be used within view of uninitiated witnesses.
	The spell takes time (40 turns) to activate, and you must be out of sight of any other creature when you cast it and when the timeportation takes effect.
entries.target:
允许你传送至时空守卫的大本营：零点圣域。
	你曾在那里研习时空魔法，并获授一道特殊的传送门法术，可传送回去。
	此法术必须保密；绝不能在未入门的目击者视线内使用。
	法术需要 40 回合才能生效。施法时以及时间传送生效时，你都必须处于其他任何生物的视线之外。

entries.source: Random Artifact (dropped on death) added to main inventory
entries.target: 随机神器（死亡后掉落）将会被加入到主要物品栏

entries.source:
You are hunted!.
		There is a %d%% chance each turn that all foes in a %d radius get a glimpse of your position for 30 turns.
entries.target:
你被捕猎了！
		每回合有 %d%% 的几率使半径 %d 格内的所有敌人察觉你的位置，持续 30 回合。

entries.source: %s's %s #SALMON#CONSUMES THE SOUL#LAST# of %s, gaining the power of %s!
entries.target: %s的%s #SALMON#吞噬了%s的灵魂#LAST#，获得了%s的能力！

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#Various alchemists around Maj'Eyal are competing to gain entry into the great Brotherhood of Alchemists, and one or more have enlisted your aid.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#很多马基·埃亚尔的炼金术士想竞争加入强大的炼金术士兄弟会，其中有一个或者几个人请求你的帮助。#WHITE#

entries.source: Your telekinetically-wielded bow automatically attacks the nearest target each turn.
entries.target: 你的念动弓箭每回合会向最近目标自动射击。

entries.source: This dark red heart still beats despite being separated from its owner.  It also snuffs out any light source that comes near it.
entries.target: 这颗暗红色的心脏虽然离开了它的主人，但仍在跳动着。它还会熄灭任何靠近它的光源。

entries.source: I will not let you down.
and given to the children as a plaything
Berethh is dead, may he rest in peace.
entries.target: 贝里斯已死，但愿他能安息。

entries.source:
As you die in a dream you suddenly wake up.
Poisonous fumes take their toll on your body!
entries.target:
当你在梦中死去时，你突然醒来。
呛在有毒的烟雾中让你浑身不适！

entries.source: A stairway out appears at your feet. The Lord says: 'And remember, you are MINE. I will call you.'
entries.target: 一道通往外界的楼梯出现在你脚下。盗贼领主说道：“记住，你是我的人。我会召唤你的。”

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The Master crumbles before you, vanquished. Yet in the blink of an eye you see his form recreating from dust; unharmed and ready to fight again!*#WHITE#
Ahah you fool! See how even death has no meaning for me; for I am the Master and you are my toy, now and forever.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*领主在你面前倒下，化成灰烬。突然，你发现他从尘土里站了起来，毫发未伤，正准备战斗！*#WHITE#
啊哈，你这个愚蠢的傻瓜！看吧，死亡对我毫无意义；我是主人，你只是我的玩具，永远如此。
训练时空守卫的专有特技。

entries.source: You cannot do that without a telekinetically-wielded bow.
entries.target: 你没有灵能持握弓箭，无法这么做。

entries.source: The Diaries of King Toknor the Brave (%d)
entries.target: 勇敢者图库纳王的日记 (%d)

entries.source: Uhh, sorry I hear my father calling, see you.
entries.target: 呃，不好意思，我听到我父亲在叫我了，再见。

entries.source: You do not have any equipped items that it can be attached to.
entries.target: 你没有已装备的、可供它附加的物品。

entries.source:
This sandworm seems to not care about your presence at all and simply continues digging its way through the sand.
	
Maybe following it is the only way to move around here...
entries.target: 这只沙虫似乎毫不在意你的出现，只顾埋头挖掘。也许跟着它才能找到出路。

entries.source: A choker made of pure flame, casting forever shifting patterns around the neck of its wearer. Its fire seems to not harm the wearer.
entries.target: 一个由火焰形成的护符，在它的佩戴者身上不断地改变着形状。它的火焰似乎不会伤害到佩戴者。

entries.source:
Call upon the luck and cunning of the Little Folk to increase your critical strike chance by %d%% and your saves by %d for 5 turns.
		The bonus will increase with your Cunning.
entries.target:
召唤小不点的幸运和机智来提高你 %d%% 暴击率和 %d 豁免 5 回合。
		受灵巧影响，此效果有额外增益。

entries.source: precipitate ice walls (lasting 10 turns) within your Winter Storm's area
entries.target: 强化冰风暴的冰雪，冻结成冰墙，持续 10 回合。

entries.source: Krogar told you to go to the west and look for the Kruk Pride.
entries.target: 克洛加尔告诉你去西面寻找克鲁克部落。

entries.source:
A strong body is key to a strong mind, and a strong mind can be powerful enough to make a strong body.
		This prodigy grants a Mindpower bonus equal to 60%% of your Strength.
		Additionally, you treat all weapons as having an additional 40%% Willpower modifier.
entries.target:
强壮的身体才能承载强大的灵魂。而强大的灵魂却可以创造一个强壮的身体。
		获得相当于你 60%% 力量值的精神强度增益。
		此外，你的所有武器都会有额外的 40%% 意志修正加成。

entries.source: #ANTIQUE_WHITE#The light from the two blades fades as they are separated.
entries.target: #ANTIQUE_WHITE#两把利刃分开时耀眼的闪光消失了。

entries.source: Learned the five chapters of the Legend of Garkul.
entries.target: 阅读了有关兽人传奇加库尔的5章文献。

entries.source:
You call upon the immediate help of your Halves.
		Your Stone Half will trade places (if in sight) with you and all creatures currently targetting you in a radius of %d will target it instead.
		Your Crystaline Half will instantly fire a volley of level %d earthen missiles at all foes near the stone half (or you if the stone half is dead) in radius %d.
		In addition, as passive effect, your halves now also learn your level of Combat Accuracy.
entries.target:
你立即呼唤分身协助。
		若岩石分身在视线内，它会与你交换位置；半径 %d 内当前以你为目标的所有生物都会转而攻击它。
		水晶分身会立即发射一轮等级 %d 的岩石飞弹，攻击岩石分身附近半径 %d 内的所有敌人（若岩石分身已死，则改以你为中心）。
		此外，作为被动效果，你的分身也会习得与你相同等级的强化命中。
